sections.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Image 1 is the exact daytime terrain section station-yard 0-0; edit ONLY its lighting to calm nighttime for The Lantern Atlas. Image 2 is the nighttime color/brightness reference. Preserve every cobble, crack, mortar line, blade of grass, curb, ramp, canal bank, water outline and edge intersection at exactly the same pixels. No movement, crop, zoom, rotation, geometry change or new objects. Keep the target's 432:304 aspect ratio, output approximately 1494 by 1052 pixels and at least 1450x1024 native pixels. Night lighting: clear muted blue-gray paving, desaturated dark olive grass and soil, deep blue-teal water with faint silver-blue ripples if present. Any warm lamps and moving objects will be separately placed sprites, so do not paint lamps, illumination pools, objects, buildings, trees, characters, stars, text, labels, border or UI. Preserve painterly crisp fine detail. Output only the matching nighttime section.
